objective: Determine which candidate response structure remains compatible with the observations after a bounded set of permitted interventions. Preserve an equivalence class or abstain when the allowed probes do not identify one mechanism.

scope.description: Synthetic scalar response process with a bounded experiment interface.
scope.claim_scope: Development contract fixture only; no physical-world or scientific-discovery claim.

observation_channels.description: Observed response after the declared intervention and process evolution.

interventions.description: Apply a bounded input level for the declared duration.

budget.compute_unit_definition: Development-only abstract search units; not CPU time, FLOPs, GPU time or energy.

evidence_profile.claim_ceiling: Schema and consumer-conformance discussion only; not a benchmark result.
